image_description: A medium shot of two individuals outdoors on a paved street with buildings in the background. The primary subject is a woman in the foreground wearing a purple and black academic gown with velvet bars on the sleeves, a white stole, and a black mortarboard cap. A secondary subject in the mid-ground wears a white and black academic gown with text on the back. Both subjects are standing/walking.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The garment on the main subject is not full-length; it ends around the knees/thighs, revealing black trousers/skirt underneath. The silhouette is not strictly rectangular due to the open front and layering.
The gown has a clear center-front opening and appears bilaterally symmetric in its cut, though the drape varies due to pose.
The sleeves and shoulder area are voluminous and obscure the upper body contours, although the lower body is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeves are wide and bell-shaped, hanging significantly below the wrists/hands, consistent with academic regalia.
The gown is open-front with no visible buttons, zippers, or distinct closure panels; it relies on drape rather than mechanical closure.
The gown is worn over a white shirt/stole and dark bottoms, consistent with formal academic dress.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears heavy and matte, absorbing light rather than reflecting it, consistent with wool or polyester blends.
The surface texture is smooth without high-gloss reflections, except for slight sheen on the velvet bars which is expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeves clearly extend well past the wrists, creating the characteristic bell shape.

artifact_observations.location: Back of the white gown on the secondary subject (left)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the back of the white gown is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than clear lettering. It lacks structural coherence.

artifact_observations.location: Lower legs/feet of the secondary subject (left)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The feet and lower legs of the person in the white gown appear to merge with the ground/shadows. The shoe structure is indistinct and lacks clear definition, suggesting minor melting or grounding issues.

artifact_observations.location: Face and hair of the primary subject (right)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking natural pore detail. Hair strands blend slightly into the background sky/building edge, indicating minor boundary bleeding.
